10 please the Court:

16 Ninth Circuit held that it was sufficient that
17 Respondents have connections to Nevada, and that Officer
18 Walden allegedly targeted his conduct at them, knowing
19 of their contacts with Nevada. That plaintiff­centered
20 approach is inconsistent with this Court's precedence
21 which emphasize that the defendant himself must have
22 meaningful contacts with the forum State.

25 the effects of Officer Walden's alleged conduct in
